name: debt: a return whose clawback exceeds the member's remaining points leaves debt, and the next earn repays it first
note: The member starts owing 100 points, so available = lots 0 - debt 100 = -100. Order O-12001: amount 3000 / 100 = 30 points; the earn repays 30 of the debt before it creates any lot, so debt goes 100 -> 70 and no lot is created; available goes -100 -> -70, so expectedPoints 30 and expectedLedgerDelta +30. Return R-12001 returns the full 3000, so the order's new worth is 0 and the clawback is 30; the order's own lot is empty because its 30 points repaid debt, so the clawback exceeds what remains of what was granted and 30 becomes debt; available goes -70 -> -100, so expectedPoints 30 and expectedLedgerDelta -30. The next earn O-12002: amount 12000 / 100 = 120 points; it repays the remaining 100 debt first and creates one lot of 120 - 100 = 20; debt goes 100 -> 0 and available goes -100 -> +20, so expectedPoints 120 and expectedLedgerDelta +120, split as 100 repaid debt and 20 to a new lot.
